data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002 inherits from SRC_001 because the monotonicity-based uniqueness proof (D(299)=789 < D(300)=792 < D(301)=795) presupposes the digit-width block decomposition that SRC_001 establishes: the jump from D(299) to D(300) is exactly 3 digits only because both page numbers fall within the 3-digit block (100–999) identified by SRC_001's partition. It is refuted if the monotonicity of D(n) can be established independently of the block structure—for example, via a general argument that len(str(n)) ≥ 1 for all n ≥ 1—without any inheritance from the specific partition.
